CustomObject.description: Deprecated, superseded by CursorBatch_Event_Ledger__c. Stored (Job, ReplayId) for idempotent processing of CursorBatch_WorkerComplete__e events, but only for stateful jobs, and rows were deleted when the job completed -- so a replay arriving after completion found no marker. The framework no longer writes here. Existing rows are inert and can be deleted once drained.
CustomObject.label: Cursor Batch Processed Event
